title: Address multilingual and localisation requirements for semantic content
requirements:
- Treat language, accessibility, local concepts and inclusive participation as obligations across the lifecycle
- Prefer official language releases and label local or machine translations
- Cover translations and locale conventions in 3.5.3.1 and Appendix C
- Support multilingual labels and accessible publication where the registry serves public, clinical or dispensing use
- Govern translation as clinical-meaning work, with provenance and prioritisation by need
- Require review status and clinical validation of translations
- Provide accessible review formats and feedback channels for non-specialists and underrepresented implementers
- Monitor representation and translation gaps; require accessible, multilingual documentation formats
